Title: Retrieve paginated orders for a shop filtered by order gender
Preconditions: Shop with ID exists in the system and has at least one order with the specified gender
Steps:
1. Send a GET request to /api/orders/shop/{shopId}/orderGender/{orderGender}?page=0&limit=10, replacing {shopId} and {orderGender} with actual values. 2. Verify the response status and body.

Test Data: shopId=1, orderGender=male, page=0, limit=10
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK response with a JSON body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Orders retrieved successfully", "data": {"content": [<list of order summaries>], "pageable": {"pageNumber": 0, "pageSize": 10}, "totalElements": <non-zero number>, "totalPages": <number>}}. The 'content' array contains orders with orderGender='male'.
